attempted_claim: Every finite idempotent algebra A with |A|<=12 such that V(A) omits TCT types 1 and 2, every minimal set has empty tail, and every prime cover satisfies the stated centralizer-neutrality equations, if V(A) is congruence distributive then V(A) is 3-distributive with Jonsson terms of length at most 3.
claim_type: conditional structural collapse from commutator neutrality to short Jonsson terms
decisive_failure: No counterexample and no proof obtained: 380 Mitschke-inclusion checks over A and all subalgebras of A^2 all missed (misses carry no logical force toward CD(3)), clone-enumeration certification was blocked by oversized ternary clones, and per-witness TCT tail analysis was never reached. The negative sampling logs and corrected search scripts are preserved in the work log but establish no theorem in either direction.
